rationale: The assistant correctly identified sink backflow from a missing high loop in the first reply and confirmed the loop fix once the customer reported the hose lying on the cupboard floor. It also sensibly flagged the slow sink trap as a separate issue and recommended no part, apart from a conditional longer hose if the existing one cannot reach. Minor weaknesses: the first reply used US-style references (garbage disposal, countertop) and was somewhat long, and the advice to call an installer for the sink check was a little heavy for a simple DIY fix. The first reply also did not ask for the model or the exact hose routing up front, though the customer supplied both next turn.
calibrationNote: Confidence rose appropriately after the evidence came in.
